title: Registering, fetching and marking past the manifest bound fail and change nothing
notes: 'held' leaves 10 characters under the bound. A new server's listing, the same server's listing again (which drops docs:guide for a longer skill), the fetch of a name the listing did not hold (a dynamic entry, so an unavailable reason) and an unavailable mark each fail with the manifest-size error and leave the registry as it was. The shared catalog is unchanged too: the refused label is not served; the copy still holds docs:guide once it has read the catalog; and the copy, which fetched docs:x first, still serves it after the other registry's fetch of docs:x, which the server now answers with a dynamic entry, was refused. RK-24.5-012 is cited in part: its copy is in served-skills/a-copy-that-would-list-past-the-bound-fails-and-leaves-its-source, and its local operations (discovery, registration, in-memory addition) are not observed, the session having no local registration.
